blocks.content: River capture occurs when a stronger river diverts the headwaters of a weaker river through headward erosion.

items: Headward erosion is frequently tested as the specific mechanism causing stream piracy.
In river capture, the stronger river diverts the flow from the headwaters of the weaker river.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: River capture is also referred to as stream piracy.
The process involves a stronger river diverting the headwaters of a weaker river.
Headward erosion is the main geological mechanism behind river capture.
